description: This Java source file defines a command handler class 'DisburseLoanToSavingsCommandHandler' responsible for processing commands to disburse a loan to a savings account within the Apache Fineract project. It implements the 'NewCommandSourceHandler' interface, is annotated as a service, and uses transaction management to ensure proper processing.

classes.name: DisburseLoanToSavingsCommandHandler
classes.description: A Spring service component that handles commands for disbursing loans to savings accounts, implementing the 'NewCommandSourceHandler' interface, and executing the disbursement within a transactional context.

methods.name: processCommand
methods.description: Processes the disbursement command, delegating to the 'LoanWritePlatformService.disburseLoan' method, and returns the result of the operation.
